description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Legend', which is responsible for creating and managing legends in a graph plotting library. It includes methods for layout, rendering, and configuration of legend placement, appearance, and associated plot areas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Legend
classes.description: A class that displays a legend for a plot area. It can be positioned as an overlay or alongside the plot area, and supports configuration of markers, alignment, and associated plot areas.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Legend
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the legend and sets default padding.

methods.name: _plotCount
methods.description: Counts and returns the number of plot elements within the assigned plot areas.

methods.name: _parameterArray
methods.description: Generates a default parameter array for legend rendering, including positioning and style options.

methods.name: _height
methods.description: Calculates and returns the height of the legend element on the canvas.

methods.name: _width
methods.description: Calculates and returns the width of the legend element on the canvas.

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.description: Sets the alignment of the legend within its parent container.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the coordinates of the legend based on alignment and parent dimensions.

methods.name: setPlotarea
methods.description: Associates a plot area with the legend for display.

methods.name: _setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent object, establishing the chain to the graph object.

methods.name: setShowMarker
methods.description: Configures whether markers should be shown on the legend items.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the legend on the canvas, including borders, plot items, and alignment adjustments.
